pairs.subject: remote-capability-probing
pairs.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:50 Guide topic bodies come from bundled modules loaded with a build-time dynamic import, not from a remote store run by someone else; a case-insensitive search of src/app/guide for accept-ranges, fetch(, probe, capabilit and bytes= found nothing, and the same search over src/ found no Accept-Ranges, bytes= or 206 handling, so nothing here needs a per-peer capability verdict.

techniques.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:50 No read path branches on a capability header from a peer; content is a bundled import.
src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:93 The only read is a local module loader, so there is no probe or round trip to an outside host.
src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:95 A missing topic resolves to notFound; there is no fallback from a fragment read to a whole-object transfer.
